concepts.def: Universal Declaration of Human Rights; 30 articles; drafted partly by Christian and Jewish thinkers after Holocaust.
Human created in God's image (Genesis 1:27); Christian basis for human dignity and rights.
Latin American Catholic movement from 1960s; Gustavo Gutierrez; 'preferential option for the poor' against oppression.
Article 18 UDHR; Christian persecution in some Muslim states; UK Equality Act 2010 protects religion or belief.
Religions emphasise care for poor; Christianity Matthew 25; Islam zakah; Jewish tzedakah; Buddhist dana.
Baptist minister led US civil rights movement; non-violence; Letter from Birmingham Jail; assassinated 1968.
